settings.heading: Recognition Gifts for Different Career Milestones
settings.closing_text: These are suggestions, not fixed packages. Planning a recurring program? See our Milestone Program, or explore more employee recognition gifts.

settings.title: Tell Us About Your Recognition Project
settings.text: Share the milestones you want to recognize, the number of employees, product ideas, your company logo and the date you need the gifts.

settings.title: Choose Your Gifts
settings.text: Select awards, Parker pens, business card holders, or a combination. We can help you match products to each milestone.

settings.title: Review Your Design
settings.text: We prepare a free digital mockup showing names, service years, messages and logo placement for your review.

settings.title: Approve Your Order
settings.text: Approve the final design and details. Production begins after approval and payment.

settings.title: Production & Fulfillment
settings.text: We engrave and prepare your order for delivery. Production and delivery timing is confirmed with your quote.

settings.question: Can every award have a different employee name?
settings.answer: Yes. Eligible products can carry individual names, service years or messages within one coordinated order. Send your recipient list and the wording you want for each person. Engraving options depend on the selected product and the available engraving area.

settings.question: Can I add our company logo?
settings.answer: Yes, on compatible products. You can upload your logo with your quote request, and we review the artwork and engraving placement before production. A free digital mockup shows the design for your approval.

settings.question: Do you offer gifts for different service milestones?
settings.answer: Yes. You can personalize awards, Parker pens and business card holders for milestones such as 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25+ years of service, or for retirement. The suggestions on this page are starting points, not fixed packages.

settings.question: Do awards and Parker pens come with gift boxes?
settings.answer: Many awards and Parker pens include standard packaging, and upgraded gift presentation may be available upon request. We confirm the packaging for your selected products with your quote.

settings.question: Can we order recognition gifts for multiple employees?
settings.answer: Yes. Send your recipient list with names, milestone years and any wording for each person, along with the products you are considering. We will confirm quantities, pricing and details with your quote.

settings.question: How far in advance should we order?
settings.answer: Timing depends on the product, quantity, engraving details, artwork approval and inventory availability. Share the date you need the gifts when you request a quote, and we will confirm the project schedule with it. Shipping time is separate.

settings.heading: Make Every Year of Service Worth Celebrating
settings.text: Show employees how much their dedication means with personalized recognition gifts made for their milestones.
